description: Defines a class for storing and manipulating delivery limitations for ads, specifically for limitations that are not based on time/date, day, or hour. Includes properties for logical operator, type, comparison, data, and execution order, as well as methods for construction and checking if delivery is blocked.

classes.name: OA_Maintenance_Priority_DeliveryLimitation_Empty
classes.description: A class used to store and manipulate individual delivery limitations for ads, where the limitation is not of the Time:Date, Time:Day, or Time:Hour type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the delivery limitation object with provided parameters: logical operator, type, comparison, data, and execution order.

methods.name: deliveryBlocked
methods.description: Determines if the delivery is blocked based on the stored limitation; always returns false as this class does not block delivery.
